##### Technologies Supporting Mission-Critical Applications

Aptiv has the products, technologies and expertise that companies rely on to deliver performance and
reliability for the long haul. Our software runs intelligent edge devices from vehicles to
airplanes, and from industrial robots to cellular base stations, while our hardware and connectors
handle the toughest environmental conditions.

## Sensing solutions, end to end.

Pressure pulses in a turbine. CO₂ ppm in a hospital ward. Coolant temperature inside an EV battery
pack. Across 16 solution families, our brands turn the messy analog world into clean, reliable
signals — engineered to outlast the systems they serve.

[

### Pressure

Absolute, gauge and differential pressure across MEMS and bonded technologies.

][60][

### Temperature

NTC, RTD, thermopile and silicon temperature sensors.

Accelerometers, sound level meters and dynamic measurement.

### Position

Contactless Hall-effect, magnetostrictive and rotary position sensing.

][63][

Ultrasonic and capacitive fluid level and concentration sensing.

][64][

Ultrasonic transducers for marine, industrial and fluid sensing.

][66][

Wireless rotating-shaft telemetry and condition monitoring.

][67][

Direct TPMS sensors for passenger vehicles and commercial fleets.

][68][

### Passive Entry Passive Start (PEPS)

Low-frequency antenna sensors for keyless entry systems.

][69][

### Thermal Validation

Wireless thermal mapping and validation for GxP processes.

][70][

### Current

Contactless current sensing for power, motor and battery systems.

][71][

### Tilt (Inclination)

Inclination and tilt sensing for off-road, construction and industrial equipment.

][72][

### Speed

Speed and rotation sensing for transmission, motor and powertrain systems.

][73][

### Moisture Meters

Handheld and fixed moisture measurement instruments.

][74][

Sonar and net-monitoring sensors for commercial fishing.

We are the Adaptive Powerhouse for Future Mobility, making it safe, exciting, connected, and
autonomous.

To achieve this goal, we develop, produce and supply technologically leading and market-oriented
products, hardware, software and modern mobility solutions. In addition, we offer various services.
Our diverse portfolio features a multitude of extremely well-established products and underpins our
strong market position.

## Our solutions

[Diverse Team of Engineers Working in Office at Industrial Factory. Industrial Designers Discuss
Electric Car Augmented Reality Hologramm. Specialists Work in Technological Car Development
Facility.]

## Software-defined Vehicle

The term SDV (Software-defined Vehicle) is one of the key topics in the automotive industry - not
only for passenger cars but also for commercial vehicles.

[ Learn more ][196]
[A woman is smiling as she stands next to her electric car at a charging station in a city
environment. The scene captures modern transportation and eco-friendly living.]

## Electric Mobility

Technologies around clean and sustainable mobility are being enhanced further across the globe, with
continued focus on electric and hybrid electric vehicles.

[ Learn more ][197]
[A woman enjoys her favorite music against the backdrop of city lights.]

## Safety

No matter what, safety is not negotiable. Our overarching goal is Vision Zero, i.e., a world without
deaths, injuries, or traffic accidents.

[ Learn more ][198]
[Driver inside a modern car holding the steering wheel, with an orange overlay and digital interface
graphics representing autonomous driving and safety technology.]

## Driver Assistance

Exploring how driver assistance and autonomous mobility can revolutionize the future of driving and
contribute to accident-free roads.

[ Learn more ][199]

looking female with glad positive expression, woman in casual wear driving a car]

We design innovative solutions and develop new interface concepts for the mobility of tomorrow. We
give vehicles the “wow-effect”.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

## EV Charging Questions, Answered

How do EV charging stations work?

Electric charging stations function by converting power from the electrical grid to direct current
that electric vehicles use. DC fast chargers, which allow quick charging in minutes using higher
voltages and wattages, are only available at public stations. 

Drivers plug their vehicles into the electric vehicle charging stations, which deliver power to the
vehicle's battery charging system. When done, drivers unplug so the next EV can charge up from the
ever-flowing grid power supply. Home stations wire directly into the home's electrical system.

[Answers to your questions when installing ev chargers.][18]

Are EV charging stations worth it?

Yes, due to all the long-term benefits. See below for the three primary reasons EV charging stations
are worthwhile.
1. **Preparing for the future:** As more people embrace electric vehicles, electric charging
   infrastructure will be necessary, and businesses that install stations will position themselves
   for future success. [EVs are here to stay][19].
2. **Reduced energy costs:** EVs are cheaper than gas vehicles, saving fleet operators money on
   fuel.
3. **Customer retention/attraction:** Having an electric charging station works to attract and
   retain customers, as EV drivers frequently visit places with convenient charging stations. 

Can owning an EV charging station be profitable?

Owning an EV charging station can be a profitable business opportunity as it has recurring revenue
streams. Offering an EV charging solution provides profit from charging fees. 

As the EV market continues expanding to [meet consumer demand and sustainability goals][20], more EV
drivers will need access to a commercial charging station, increasing the volume of fees an EV
charging station collects. Locating stations in busy areas like coffee shops, restaurants,
convenience stores, and malls is a great strategy to enhance an EV charging experience, [contribute
to sustainable transportation,][21] and make more profits.

Why should I consider installing an EV charging station?

One important reason to install an electric vehicle charging station is to demonstrate your
commitment to sustainability by supporting clean energy options. Then, as EV adoption increases,
you’ll be [ahead of the curve][22] by offering electric vehicle charging availability for customers.
You can generate income from fees, subscriptions, advertising, or premium parking by providing
charging. Any place with EV charging stations makes more profits as charging drives more foot
traffic and spending at shopping centers and parks.

What factors should I consider when choosing an EV charging station?

How do EV charging stations work?

   fuel.

   retain customers, as EV drivers frequently visit places with convenient charging stations.

streams. Offering an EV charging solution provides profit from charging fees.

## MAP Sensor

## What you worry about, solved

### 01. Can’t find the exact sensor match?

Many trucks share the same engine but use different sensors by year or connector, so easy to order
the wrong part.
Send us your VIN + old-part photos, and our engineers will match OE numbers, connector type and
length before we quote and ship, cutting wrong deliveries and returns.

[ Contact Us ][11]

### 02. Not sure about goods quality?

Aftermarket parts vary, disputes in warranty.
Every batch goes through 100% inbound & outbound testing, key models get high/low temperature and
life-cycle bench tests, and each carton has a traceable batch code plus warranty support.

[ Contact Us ][12]

### 03. How do you secure shipping?

We keep safety stock on core SKUs, so most orders ship within 24–48 hours.
courier/air/sea options and full tracking with lead-time commitment help you avoid stock gaps and
costly downtime.

[ Contact Us ][13]

## WHY CHOOSE US

[ Predictable supply for wholesale programs ][14]

Multi-warehouse strategy in China with rolling safety stock on core SKUs. Weekly capacity planning
ensures stable availability during peaks. 

[ Cross-border logistics you can plan around ][15]

Consolidated shipping, export documents ready (commercial invoice, packing list, HS codes), and
carrier options for air/sea. Clear lead-time tiers: 5 days ex-works, 7-15 days door-to-door to
EU/LatAm hubs.

[ Total landed cost advantage without quality trade-offs ][16]

Tiered pricing for volume, fixed packing specs, and optimized cartons to reduce dimensional weight.
Batch-level traceability keeps warranty risk low.

[ Quality you can trace, warranty you can rely on ][17]

Two-stage QC (inbound/outbound), serialized labels, and retained samples by lot. Warranty terms
aligned for wholesale replacements and credit notes.

[ VIN and photo-matching that reduces returns ][18]

Fast model/connector verification before purchase via VIN and old-part photos. (48h confirmation
window) Low return rate on core SKUs (<0.8% rolling 12 months).

[ Compliance and documentation ready for customs ][19]

IATF 16949 processes, RoHS material declarations, IP ratings where applicable, MSDS and test reports
available per request. Smooth customs clearance reduces delays.

[ Flexible payment and risk control ][20]

Multiple trade terms (EXW/FOB/CIF/DDP by arrangement), payment options (T/T, L/C for qualified
partners), and credit lines for long-term distributors.

[ Post-sale support built for distributors ][21]

Installation guides, failure analysis reports within 3 business days, and RMA portal designed for
batch handling. Root-cause feedback loops to protect your brand.

Your message (optional)

## ABOUT US

Depth Technology Limited, headquartered in Hong Kong, is a specialized manufacturer and exporter of
high-quality truck components, with a strong focus on precision sensors for heavy-duty vehicles.
Leveraging robust production capabilities and a global outlook, we serve clients across
international markets.

Core Business

Our core business centers on the manufacturing and export of truck parts, especially sensors (e.g.,
Map sensor and Maf sensor). We supply a full range of components—from engine systems to chassis
parts—tailored for brands like Sinotruk, Shacman, and FAW. Our products are exported to regions
including Russia, Southeast Asia,Middle East, Africa, and Europe.

### [What is ADAS Calibration? ][50]

[ADAS calibration][51] (and recalibration) is the precise alignment of ADAS sensors following

and adjacent repair services. 

Calibration needs are vehicle-specific and can include in-shop calibration, on-road calibration, or
both types of procedures. Calibration requires special equipment and training. Additionally,
in-shop, or static, calibrations, require very precise measurements, in a controlled environment. 

### Modern Collision Repair with ADAS Calibration

In the past, when a vehicle was involved in a front-end collision, a technician could simply repair

  and automatically applies the vehicle’s brakes
* **[Pedestrian Detection][43]** – detects an imminent collision with a pedestrian and autonomously
  applies the brakes or alerts the driver
* **[Adaptive Cruise Control][44]** – cruise control setting that will slow down and pace a vehicle
  with the one in front of it
* **[Traffic Sign Recognition][45] **– video cameras detect some types of road signs and display
  them on a dashboard
* **[Lane Departure Warning][46]** – provides drivers with an alert when they drift out of their
  lane unintentionally
* [**Lane Keeping Assist**][47] – provides steering assistance to keep drivers in their lane

factory-specified position?

Recalibration is vital to ensure that automated warnings and vehicle actions are provided under the
right conditions. 

### [What is ADAS Calibration? ][50]

several situations: windshield replacement, collisions, changes in suspension and vehicle alignment,
and adjacent repair services.

## company strength

#### DALY BMS

To become a leading global provider of new energy solutions, DALY BMS specializes in the
manufacturing, distribution, design, research, and servicing of cutting-edge [Lithium Battery
Management Systems (BMS)][39]. With a presence spanning over 130 countries, including key markets
like India, Russia, Turkey, Pakistan, Egypt, Argentina, Spain, the US, Germany, South Korea, and
Japan, we cater to diverse energy needs worldwide.

 

As an innovative and rapidly expanding enterprise, Daly is committed to a research and development
ethos centered on “Pragmatism, Innovation, Efficiency.” Our relentless pursuit of pioneering BMS
solutions is underscored by a dedication to technological advancement. We have secured close to a
hundred patents, encompassing breakthroughs such as glue injection waterproofing and advanced
thermal conductivity control panels.

 

Count on DALY BMS for state-of-the-art solutions tailored to optimize the performance and longevity
of lithium batteries.

## company strength

#### DALY BMS

To become a leading global provider of new energy solutions, DALY BMS specializes in the
manufacturing, distribution, design, research, and servicing of cutting-edge [Lithium Battery
Management Systems (BMS)][39]. With a presence spanning over 130 countries, including key markets
like India, Russia, Turkey, Pakistan, Egypt, Argentina, Spain, the US, Germany, South Korea, and
Japan, we cater to diverse energy needs worldwide.

 

As an innovative and rapidly expanding enterprise, Daly is committed to a research and development
ethos centered on “Pragmatism, Innovation, Efficiency.” Our relentless pursuit of pioneering BMS
solutions is underscored by a dedication to technological advancement. We have secured close to a
hundred patents, encompassing breakthroughs such as glue injection waterproofing and advanced
thermal conductivity control panels.

 

Count on DALY BMS for state-of-the-art solutions tailored to optimize the performance and longevity
of lithium batteries.

### [Testing a Second-Life Nissan Leaf Battery Pack for Stationary Storage][225]

Repurposing retired EV batteries for stationary energy storage requires thorough safety validation
before deployment. Researchers at Tallinn University of Technology evaluated a second-life Nissan
Leaf battery using the Dewesoft Obsidian R8 to monitor charging behavior, pack voltage, current, and
BMS CAN data. The results confirmed stable operation, safe cell voltages, and suitability for
further stationary energy storage applications.

### [Tennis Racket Modal Analysis and Vibration Damper Testing][226]

Researchers at FH CAMPUS 02 used Dewesoft modal analysis and impact testing to compare the vibration
behavior of two tennis rackets and evaluate the effect of a vibration damper. The study showed that
racket construction strongly influences vibration, comfort, and control, while the damper has little
effect on overall structural dynamics, affecting only localized string-bed vibrations.

### [Climate Chamber Testing of a 320 kW DC Fast Charger][227]

KEBA validated its 320 kW DC fast charger in an AIT climate chamber to ensure reliable operation
under extreme temperatures. Using synchronized Dewesoft power measurements, engineers verified
thermal management, gradual power derating, efficiency, and automatic power recovery during
controlled load tests. The results confirmed safe, standards-compliant performance and reliable
charging in demanding environments.

* Battery pack modules may be connected in series and/or parallel

# Advanced machinery telematics

[Advanced machinery telematics by Technoton]

We offer comprehensive solutions for remote monitoring of road and off-road trucks, locomotives, sea
and river vessels, diesel generators (gensets), fuel storages and tanks, technological machines.
Major parameters monitored are: [fuel consumption][56], time and engine operation mode, volume and
temperature of fuel, operation of attached equipment, axle load.

**[Documentation][57]**

**[Software][58]**

**[Training][59]**

**[ODM services][60]**

**[Documentation][61]**

**[Software][62]**

**[Training][63]**

**[ODM services][64]**

Technoton [telematics solutions][65] allow machinery owners and operators to dramatically improve
efficiency of operation and decrease costs.

Our expertise:
* Fuel consumption monitoring of diesel engines
* Monitoring of stationary and movable/mobile fuel tanks
* Contactless reading, analysis and conversion of data from CAN j1939 and j1708 buses
* Data integration of standard CAN j1939 and j1708 buses into telematics and GPS monitoring systems
* Integration of standard analog sensors into telematics systems
* Monitoring of 10800+ technological parameters 24/7 in real-time

Technoton’s products are designed using technologies employing edge/fog computing methods, which
ensure accurate parameter measurement, scalability of a telematics system, reliable operation and
guaranteed compatibility of the equipment.

Since 2000, Technoton has been developing, manufacturing, and supplying fuel monitoring and
telematics solutions for remote asset visibility and analytics.

Technoton smart sensors and turnkey hardware kits are used in trucks and commercial vehicles,
trains, construction, agri- and mining machinery, marine and river vessels, power generators,
stationary fuel tanks, industrial fuel systems.

Our quality management system is ISO 9001:2015 certified.

# Advanced machinery telematics

[Advanced machinery telematics by Technoton]

We offer comprehensive solutions for remote monitoring of road and off-road trucks, locomotives, sea
and river vessels, diesel generators (gensets), fuel storages and tanks, technological machines.
Major parameters monitored are: [fuel consumption][56], time and engine operation mode, volume and
temperature of fuel, operation of attached equipment, axle load.

**[Documentation][57]**

**[Software][58]**

**[Training][59]**

**[ODM services][60]**

**[Documentation][61]**

**[Software][62]**

**[Training][63]**

**[ODM services][64]**

Technoton [telematics solutions][65] allow machinery owners and operators to dramatically improve
efficiency of operation and decrease costs.

Our expertise:
* Fuel consumption monitoring of diesel engines
* Monitoring of stationary and movable/mobile fuel tanks
* Contactless reading, analysis and conversion of data from CAN j1939 and j1708 buses
* Data integration of standard CAN j1939 and j1708 buses into telematics and GPS monitoring systems
* Integration of standard analog sensors into telematics systems
* Monitoring of 10800+ technological parameters 24/7 in real-time

Technoton’s products are designed using technologies employing edge/fog computing methods, which
ensure accurate parameter measurement, scalability of a telematics system, reliable operation and
guaranteed compatibility of the equipment.

Since 2000, Technoton has been developing, manufacturing, and supplying fuel monitoring and
telematics solutions for remote asset visibility and analytics.

Technoton smart sensors and turnkey hardware kits are used in trucks and commercial vehicles,
trains, construction, agri- and mining machinery, marine and river vessels, power generators,
stationary fuel tanks, industrial fuel systems.

Our quality management system is ISO 9001:2015 certified.

## THE LONDON EV COMPANY

### LEVC: A Legacy of Innovation and Sustainable Mobility Solutions

Since 1908, LEVC (London EV Company) has been at the forefront of British automotive craftsmanship
and innovation. Renowned for designing the first dedicated black cab for London, our brand has
become a symbol of quality, reliability, and timeless design.

In 2018, we revolutionized urban mobility with the launch of the electric TX—the world's cleanest
and most advanced taxi with groundbreaking eCity, REEV (Range-Extended Electric Vehicle) technology.
This pioneering model reflects our unwavering commitment to innovation and sustainability, helping
cities around the globe transition to greener transport solutions.

As we continue to build on our iconic heritage, LEVC is transforming into a high-volume,
all-electric automotive leader. With a forward-thinking strategy, we are dedicated to creating
smarter, cleaner, safer, and more accessible mobility solutions designed for modern living.

Our mission is to redefine the future of urban transportation—driving progress while reducing
environmental impact. Join us in setting new standards in efficiency, innovation, and excellence.

## THE LONDON EV COMPANY

### LEVC: A Legacy of Innovation and Sustainable Mobility Solutions

Since 1908, LEVC (London EV Company) has been at the forefront of British automotive craftsmanship
and innovation. Renowned for designing the first dedicated black cab for London, our brand has
become a symbol of quality, reliability, and timeless design.

In 2018, we revolutionized urban mobility with the launch of the electric TX—the world's cleanest
and most advanced taxi with groundbreaking eCity, REEV (Range-Extended Electric Vehicle) technology.
This pioneering model reflects our unwavering commitment to innovation and sustainability, helping
cities around the globe transition to greener transport solutions.

As we continue to build on our iconic heritage, LEVC is transforming into a high-volume,
all-electric automotive leader. With a forward-thinking strategy, we are dedicated to creating
smarter, cleaner, safer, and more accessible mobility solutions designed for modern living.

Our mission is to redefine the future of urban transportation—driving progress while reducing
environmental impact. Join us in setting new standards in efficiency, innovation, and excellence.

[

## A Guide to High-Reliability Automotive Connector Soldering and Inspection

][233]

In automotive electronics repair and R&D, a common saying is: "Even the top-tier chips are 'ticking
time bombs' if the soldering process is substandard."

Many engineers and technicians have encountered mysterious ECU fault codes (DTCs) or intermittent
disconnections on bumpy roads. After exhausting software and chip-level diagnostics, the culprit is
often a simple **cold solder joint** on a connector pin.

## 1. Why Soldering Quality is the ECU's "Lifeline"

Automotive environments are significantly harsher than consumer electronics. Vehicles endure:
* **High-Frequency Vibration:** Leads to physical fatigue of solder joints.
* **Thermal Cycling:** Drastic temperature changes between extreme cold and engine heat cause solder
  joints to crack.
* **Humidity and Salt Spray:** Flux residue can trigger rapid pin corrosion.

A minor cold solder joint might pass initial testing, but over time, cracks expand, leading to
intermittent failures.

## 2. Process Pitfalls: Avoiding Cold Solders & Material Selection

Automotive connector pins are often bulky, leading to rapid heat dissipation—the primary cause of
"cold" joints.
* **Automotive Solder Standard Comparison:** Choosing the right solder is vital for long-term
  reliability.
  * **SAC305 (Sn96.5/Ag3.0/Cu0.5):** The industry standard for automotive electronics. Its silver
    content ensures excellent wetting and thermal fatigue resistance, ideal for most
    high-reliability **[ECU][234]** applications.
  * **SN100C (Sn99.3/Cu0.7+Ni):** Enhanced with nickel, it offers superior hole-filling capability
    and corrosion resistance. It is more cost-effective than SAC305 and reduces tip erosion, making
    it a strong performer for cost-sensitive yet demanding automotive modules.
* **Key Process Controls:**
  * **Preheating:** Essential to minimize thermal gradients and prevent PCB warping.
  * **Temperature Control:** Ensure complete wetting; the joint should exhibit a natural "meniscus"
    shape with a glossy finish.
  * **Residue Cleaning:** Always remove flux residue to prevent corrosion.

## 3. Synergy: Reducing Solder Risk through PCB Design

High-quality joints rely not only on soldering processes but also on PCB layout optimization:
* **Thermal Relief:** Use "cross-connects" for pins connected to large ground planes to prevent heat
  dissipation from hindering solder wetting.
* **Strain Relief:** Incorporate anchor pads around connector pins to absorb mechanical stress from
  vibrations.
* **Trace Rules:** Separate high-current paths (like heating circuits) from sensitive signal lines
  to prevent EMI coupling at the solder joint.

## 4. Deep-Dive Case Study: Why Do ECUs Report Errors During Cold Starts?

In our engineering database at **[Nevsemi Electronics][235]**, we analyzed a classic P0035 fault.
The vehicle reported a "Heater Circuit Fault" during cold starts, but the code vanished once the
engine warmed up.
* **Mechanism:** Cross-section analysis revealed a microscopic "cold solder" joint resulting in high
  contact resistance.
* **Physical Process:** At freezing temperatures, metal contraction loosened the contact, increasing
  resistance beyond the ECU's threshold. As the engine warmed up, thermal expansion restored
  contact.
* **Lesson:** This is why **post-soldering resistance validation** is a red-line requirement in
  automotive production.

## 5. Detection Methods

Don't rely solely on visual inspection. A high-standard detection process includes:
1. **Visual Inspection (AOI):** A standard joint should be conical and smooth; spherical joints or
   visible cracks indicate a cold solder.
2. **Impedance Analysis:** Use a high-precision Digital Multimeter (DMM) to check for micro-ohm
   resistance variations between pins and PCB traces.
3. **X-Ray Inspection:** For critical ECU boards, industrial-grade X-ray is the most effective way
   to detect internal voids or internal pin faults.


## Summary

Soldering is a precise control of material science and thermodynamics. At Nevsemi Electronics**,**
we understand the extreme reliability requirements of the automotive industry. Whether you need
automotive-grade **[chips][236]** or professional **[parts assembly][237]** materials, we provide
comprehensive support.

[

## A Guide to High-Reliability Automotive Connector Soldering and Inspection

][233]

In automotive electronics repair and R&D, a common saying is: "Even the top-tier chips are 'ticking
time bombs' if the soldering process is substandard."

Many engineers and technicians have encountered mysterious ECU fault codes (DTCs) or intermittent
disconnections on bumpy roads. After exhausting software and chip-level diagnostics, the culprit is
often a simple **cold solder joint** on a connector pin.

## 1. Why Soldering Quality is the ECU's "Lifeline"

Automotive environments are significantly harsher than consumer electronics. Vehicles endure:
* **High-Frequency Vibration:** Leads to physical fatigue of solder joints.
* **Thermal Cycling:** Drastic temperature changes between extreme cold and engine heat cause solder
  joints to crack.
* **Humidity and Salt Spray:** Flux residue can trigger rapid pin corrosion.

A minor cold solder joint might pass initial testing, but over time, cracks expand, leading to
intermittent failures.

## 2. Process Pitfalls: Avoiding Cold Solders & Material Selection

Automotive connector pins are often bulky, leading to rapid heat dissipation—the primary cause of
"cold" joints.
* **Automotive Solder Standard Comparison:** Choosing the right solder is vital for long-term
  reliability.
  * **SAC305 (Sn96.5/Ag3.0/Cu0.5):** The industry standard for automotive electronics. Its silver
    content ensures excellent wetting and thermal fatigue resistance, ideal for most
    high-reliability **[ECU][234]** applications.
  * **SN100C (Sn99.3/Cu0.7+Ni):** Enhanced with nickel, it offers superior hole-filling capability
    and corrosion resistance. It is more cost-effective than SAC305 and reduces tip erosion, making
    it a strong performer for cost-sensitive yet demanding automotive modules.
* **Key Process Controls:**
  * **Preheating:** Essential to minimize thermal gradients and prevent PCB warping.
  * **Temperature Control:** Ensure complete wetting; the joint should exhibit a natural "meniscus"
    shape with a glossy finish.
  * **Residue Cleaning:** Always remove flux residue to prevent corrosion.

## 3. Synergy: Reducing Solder Risk through PCB Design

High-quality joints rely not only on soldering processes but also on PCB layout optimization:
* **Thermal Relief:** Use "cross-connects" for pins connected to large ground planes to prevent heat
  dissipation from hindering solder wetting.
* **Strain Relief:** Incorporate anchor pads around connector pins to absorb mechanical stress from
  vibrations.
* **Trace Rules:** Separate high-current paths (like heating circuits) from sensitive signal lines
  to prevent EMI coupling at the solder joint.

## 4. Deep-Dive Case Study: Why Do ECUs Report Errors During Cold Starts?

In our engineering database at **[Nevsemi Electronics][235]**, we analyzed a classic P0035 fault.
The vehicle reported a "Heater Circuit Fault" during cold starts, but the code vanished once the
engine warmed up.
* **Mechanism:** Cross-section analysis revealed a microscopic "cold solder" joint resulting in high
  contact resistance.
* **Physical Process:** At freezing temperatures, metal contraction loosened the contact, increasing
  resistance beyond the ECU's threshold. As the engine warmed up, thermal expansion restored
  contact.
* **Lesson:** This is why **post-soldering resistance validation** is a red-line requirement in
  automotive production.

## 5. Detection Methods

Don't rely solely on visual inspection. A high-standard detection process includes:
1. **Visual Inspection (AOI):** A standard joint should be conical and smooth; spherical joints or
   visible cracks indicate a cold solder.
2. **Impedance Analysis:** Use a high-precision Digital Multimeter (DMM) to check for micro-ohm
   resistance variations between pins and PCB traces.
3. **X-Ray Inspection:** For critical ECU boards, industrial-grade X-ray is the most effective way
   to detect internal voids or internal pin faults.


## Summary

Soldering is a precise control of material science and thermodynamics. At Nevsemi Electronics**,**
we understand the extreme reliability requirements of the automotive industry. Whether you need
automotive-grade **[chips][236]** or professional **[parts assembly][237]** materials, we provide
comprehensive support.

replacement surgery, bronchoscopies, cath labs, and so much more.

Proven expertise and experience in ENT, including overcoming registration challenges, CT and MRI

### Ophthalmology

[Scania AB is a Swedish manufacturer of heavy trucks, buses and engines, headquartered in
Södertälje, Sweden. The company focuses on commercial vehicles for long-distance haulage,
construction and distribution, and also produces engines for marine and industrial applications.]

# Welcome to Scania

Our purpose is to drive the shift towards a sustainable transport system, creating a world of
mobility that is better for business, society and the environment.

[Scania Irizar i6s PHEV 3-axle]

## [New 11-litre Super powertrain for buses and coaches][12]

Building on the launch of our 13-litre Super powertrain for people transport, we are now expanding
the platform with a new 11-litre option — the Super 11 — designed to meet the demands of both urban
and travel operations. Our new bus and coach powertrain platform delivers up to 10% fuel savings,
and 40% lower emissions with plug-in hybrid capability. Based on the award-winning Super technology,
it ensures an efficient and flexible solution for modern transport operations.

[ Discover the new powertrain ][13]

## Euro NCAP awards Scania L-cab and P-cab top safety ratings in the utility and distribution
## segment

[Scania L series cab awarded five-stars in-euro-NCAP safer-trucks-programme]
[ L-series trucks ][14]

The L-cab for utility operations is a versatile low-entry cab designed for urban and vocational use.
It combines active safety systems, including advanced emergency braking, with passive protection
such as driver and side-curtain airbags.

[ Road safety at Scania ][15]
[Scania P series cab awarded five-stars in-euro-NCAP safer-trucks-programme]
[ P-series trucks ][16]

The P-cab for distribution combines high driving position with strong all-round visibility. It
achieved the highest score in [Euro NCAP][17]’s “CitySafe” category, recognising vehicles equipped
with features designed to prevent accidents in urban environments.

[ Press release ][18]

### [News][19]

[ [An aerial shot of Scania's industry site in Rugao, China.] ][20]

#### [Scania marks historic milestone with new global industrial hub in China][21]

Scania opens its third global industrial hub in China, further strengthening its commitment to
sustainable transport and growth in the world’s largest truck market.

[ [Scania truck on a road summertime] ][22]

#### [Scania Performance Summary Q2][23]

Scania performed strongly during the second quarter of 2026. Truck order intake increased
significantly, vehicle deliveries rose and service revenues continued to grow compared with the same
period last year. 

[ [Autonomous truck sensor] ][24]

#### [Autonomous trucks can help address transport industry’s driver shortage issue][25]

Will driverless vehicles reduce the need for human drivers? At Scania, we believe technology and
people will complement each other.

[ [An electric Scania truck for bulk transport.] ][26]

#### [Scania in landmark deal to sell 105 battery-electric trucks to Wibax][27]

Scania has signed a landmark deal with Wibax for 105 battery-electric trucks, helping scale
sustainable bulk transport across the Nordic region.

[ Go to our newsroom ][28]

### Scania introduces - the new Super 11-litre engine

Scania launches a new member in the Scania Super family – the Super 11 engine. A lighter, more
efficient solution for high-performance transport. With a compact footprint, up to 7 percent fuel
savings and Scania’s signature engineering intelligence, the new Super 11 engine expands the Super
powertrain portfolio to meet the needs of weight-sensitive and energy-efficient applications.

[ Discover Super 11 ][29]
[ [Super 11] ][30]
[Two Scania employees in the gearbox assembly in Södertälje]

## [We drive real change][31]

With some 58,000 employees in more than 100 countries,  Scania is a truly global player. At Scania
you’ll be part of a company with over 130-year track record of innovation, as we continue on our
ambitious journey to drive the shift towards sustainable transport.

[Join the Scania team][32]
[ [ Scania steering wheel] ][33]

### [Transport solutions][34]

By combining smart transport solutions, technological innovation and partnerships, we’re working to
make sustainable transport a reality.

[Discover Scania’s transport solutions][35]
[ [ scania truck on a bridge] ][36]

### [Our commitments][37]

Our Science based targets commits us to reduce emissions at the scale and pace science dictates
necessary to limit global warming.

[Scania’s sustainability commitments][38]
[ [View from the windshield in a Scania 25 P BEV 4x2 general cargo transport] ][39]

Scania provides a wide range of safety solutions to protect driver
